from collections import Counter
s='''5 2 2 5 6 5 5 8 5 7 7 7 5 6 5
2 5 2 5 5 6 5 5 5 7 7 7 6 6 6
2 2 2 5 5 5 8 5 5 7 5 5 6 6 6
5 5 5 6 6 6 9 9 9 5 0 5 7 7 7
2 5 2 6 6 6 5 9 9 5 5 0 7 7 7
5 5 5 6 6 5 5 9 9 5 5 5 7 5 7
5 6 6 5 7 5 5 5 7 6 6 6 5 5 8
6 6 6 7 7 5 5 5 5 6 6 6 5 5 5
6 6 6 5 7 5 5 5 5 6 6 6 5 5 8
5 0 5 5 5 0 5 5 5 5 6 6 1 5 1
5 0 0 5 5 5 5 0 0 5 5 5 5 5 5
5 5 5 0 5 5 5 5 5 6 6 5 5 5 1
0 0 0 6 6 6 5 9 5 7 7 7 9 9 9
0 5 5 6 6 5 5 5 5 7 7 5 5 9 9
0 0 0 6 6 5 5 5 5 7 5 5 5 9 9'''
g=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in s.splitlines()]
out=[]
for br in range(5):
 row=[]
 for bc in range(5):
  vals=[g[r][c] for r in range(br*3,(br+1)*3) for c in range(bc*3,(bc+1)*3) if g[r][c]!=5]
  ct=Counter(vals)
  top=max(ct.values(),default=0)
  modes=[x for x,n in ct.items() if n==top]
  print((br,bc),ct, '=>', modes)
  row.append(modes[0] if modes else 0)
 out.append(row)
print('OUTPUT')
for row in out: print(row)
